title: Ion Flight
tagline: Predict, time, and explain what a flight-time detector can reveal
hub_blurb: Predict and time ion flights, then use detector evidence to separate mass and charge effects without claiming more than the trace shows.
card_blurb: Run three linked ion comparisons, use detector evidence to separate mass and charge effects, and discover why different ions can share one flight-time peak.
description: **Ion Flight** — an offline guided linear TOF investigation. Predict and run mass, charge, and equal-ratio comparisons; watch the fixed-scale flight; then explain what the summed detector trace can and cannot establish. Includes an optional peak-width extension and printable teacher guide.
